From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Subject: Webinar: Greenroom staffing, sponsor coverage, and slide ownership

Team —

We need to lock staffing and slide ownership for next Wednesday's webinar with StratifyCloud. High-level asks: ensure every external speaker has a dedicated greenroom liaison, a backup internal SME in case of questions, and that sponsor assets (logo, 30s message) are slotted into the run-of-show. I attached the current bios and ROS (run_of_show_v3.pdf) — please review.

Proposed assignments (first pass):
- Host/moderator: Lauren — overall show timing and MC cues.
- Greenroom lead: Soojin — pre-show check 30 minutes prior, mic checks, handoff to host.
- Sponsor liaison: Priyom (me) — collect final sponsor asset and confirm intro copy.
- Backup SME pool: Karthik (primary contact for model latency questions), Lauren (backup for product roadmap), Soojin (backup for live-demo jump-in).

Specific asks:
1) Lauren: confirm the slide owner for the product demo (who is advancing and who speaks for each slide). We need slide-level ownership in the deck.
2) Karthik: add a 90-second technical fallback script that can be used if the live demo drops.
3) Soojin: confirm AV contact and quiet-room allocation (two quiet rooms reserved: QR1 for host/guest, QR2 for panelists).
4) Marta/Alan (StratifyCloud): please confirm sponsor assets by EOD Monday — logo variants and the 30s sponsor read.

Attachments: speaker_bios_v2.docx, run_of_show_v3.pdf, sponsor_logos.zip

Thanks — brief sync tomorrow morning at 9:30 PT if that works.

Priyom Das

Priyom — thanks for the note. 9:30 PT tomorrow works for me. Quick responses inline: 

- Slide ownership: I propose the following owners inside the deck:
  • Intro & agenda (slide 1-3) — Lauren (host)
  • Customer story (slide 4-6) — Alan Hsu (guest) on slides, I will advance for him; Soojin to cue visuals.
  • Product demo (slide 7-12) — Karthik speaks to system architecture and I will demo the flow; Karthik to own slide 7-9 talk track, Lauren to own 10-12 live walkthrough.
  • Q&A prompt slide — Soojin to monitor Q&A and surface priority questions.

- I can build a single master slide ownership tab (hidden) in the deck with the owner initials and a 1-line talking point for each slide by EOD Monday.

- Quiet rooms: confirmed with Ops — QR1 next to greenroom A for host + guest, QR2 for panelists. AV contact is Miguel (miguel.santos@avpartners.io) — looping Karthik for AV clearance.

Small ask: can someone keep a one-pager of sponsor read copy next to the sponsor slide so the host isn't scrambling? Priyom, can you own that?

— Lauren

- Slide handoff cadence suggestion (micros):
  • 00:00-02:30 — Host intro + sponsor read (30s)
  • 02:30-12:00 — Customer story + product overview (Alan + host)
  • 12:00-24:00 — Product demo (Lauren + Karthik)
  • 24:00-30:00 — Q&A and close

I'll attach the PDF export and short fallback script (will be included in the shared drive).
